Chapter 1004 17 "Infinite Void" (Please Subscribe)

Chaos Void.

Chaos Qi drifting.

A vast Chaos Continent raced forward, continuously crossing great stretches of spacetime, advancing toward its predetermined destination.

On the Chaos Continent, Lin Yuan's gaze remained calm, clearly sensing the distance between himself and his true self rapidly growing further apart.

If not for stepping into the twelfth tier, with his mental will surging, he might not have been able to maintain this avatar at this moment.

"My spacetime perception has already reached the peak of the Seventh Realm. The maximum range this avatar can operate within is a thousandfold, even ten thousandfold higher than before stepping into the twelfth tier; it's sufficient."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

To avoid the aftermath of an impending battle between two Chaos Great Saints, the Chaos Continent of Ancient Ming began its migration after the conclusion of the Thousand Treasures Convention.

Lin Yuan's avatar stayed behind on the Chaos Continent of Ancient Ming, serving as an "anchor point."

In Lin Yuan's vision, after the great cosmic destruction of his home universe, the new home of human civilization would likely be near the Chaos Continent of Ancient Ming.

First, being close to a Chaos Continent would provide undeniable safety.

Second, the Ancient Ming Venerable was quite benevolent and stable in temperament; otherwise, he wouldn't have publicly announced that the original region was about to become the battlefield of the two Great Saints.

After the great cosmic destruction, stability would be the most crucial factor for the new home of human civilization.

Life from the universe would have just entered the Chaos Void and would require a stable environment for adaptation.

"Let's take a look."

Lin Yuan stepped out of the inn and headed toward the trading district of Mingchuan City.

"Galaxy, why not come by our shop for a look? We've just received a batch of new goods, specializing in enjoyment."

"Galaxy, what's the use of enjoyment? If you've got the money, better to buy a suitable weapon. Our shop has the largest selection of weapons..."

As Lin Yuan walked through the area, several twelfth-tier Path Splitting Realm beings greeted him proactively.

Although he was merely an avatar, the aura Lin Yuan displayed was that of a Path Splitting Realm at its peak, more than enough to intimidate most Path Splitting Realm beings.

In the Chaos Void, twelfth-tier Path Splitting Realm beings were qualified to roam freely, but there weren't many who reached the peak of the Path Splitting Realm, and beings at the Dominator Realm were even fewer.

As for Chaos Venerables? They were titans ruling their domain, beings that ordinary Path Splitting Realm existences could hardly even encounter.

Despite being an avatar, Lin Yuan possessed the strength of a peak Path Splitting Realm being, naturally attracting efforts from many Path Splitting Realm beings seeking friendship; after all, one more ally meant one more path forward.

Lin Yuan smiled and exchanged greetings as he went, quickly arriving at the front of a palace.

"Galaxy, you've come." A middle-aged man with heavy wings stepped forward to greet him.

"Wanqu, how's it going? Do you have a suitable fragment world that meets my requirements?"

Fragment worlds were the "fragment meteors" orbiting around the Chaos Continent of Ancient Ming. These could be slightly modified to become excellent places of residence, thus earning the name "fragment worlds."

"Hahaha, Galaxy, your requirements for fragment worlds—large enough and entirely free of radiation—are hard to meet," the middle-aged man with heavy wings remarked, shaking his head.

The so-called "fragment meteors" were formed from a mix of various materials in the Chaos Void, eventually drawn by the gravitational pull of the Chaos Continent to orbit it.

The composition of these materials was complex, with many emitting radiation effects.

Twelfth-tier Path Splitting Realm beings could naturally ignore such effects, but weaker beings?

Those at the eighth tier, ninth tier, or even the first and second tiers? Prolonged exposure to such radiation wasn't beneficial.

"That's precisely why I've come to you, Wanqu," Lin Yuan said with a smile.

Wanqu, one of the disciples of the Ancient Ming Venerable, was specifically responsible for overseeing the fragment meteors orbiting the Chaos Continent of Ancient Ming.

"Since you've come to me, Galaxy, I'll make sure it's handled perfectly," Wanqu said, looking at Lin Yuan and shaking his head with a wry smile.

In truth, most Path Splitting Realm beings regarded Lin Yuan as the pinnacle of the Path Splitting Realm, but Wanqu, being a dominant force himself, had already concluded that Lin Yuan was also a being at the Dominator level.

After all, Wanqu had determined that Lin Yuan before him was not the true self but merely an avatar.

An avatar that exuded the aura and strength of a peak Dominator Realm being? There was no doubt that the true Lin Yuan belonged firmly to the Dominator Realm.

Precisely for this reason, Wanqu treated Lin Yuan as a brother; otherwise, as a disciple of the Ancient Ming Venerable, how could Wanqu care about a mere Path Splitting Realm pinnacle?

"In fact, there are indeed a few fragment worlds that meet your criteria, Galaxy."

Wanqu lifted his hand, and several miniature "fragment meteors" appeared before Lin Yuan. These were scaled-down replicas of fragment meteors orbiting the Chaos Continent of Ancient Ming.

"These?"

Lin Yuan immediately grew interested. "How many Chaos Stones?"

"This fragment world—180,000 Chaos Stones, that one—170,000 Chaos Stones..." Wanqu began his introductions.

"Too expensive." Lin Yuan shook his head.

For the purpose of finding a new home for human civilization, Lin Yuan had already negotiated with nine supreme beings, deciding that the Chaos Stones for this purchase would come from the Human Civilization Treasury, with a budget set between 120,000 and 150,000 Chaos Stones.

"Expensive, huh?"

Wanqu nodded thoughtfully. "Indeed, they are a bit pricey, but these fragment worlds are entirely free of radiation impact, making them ideal for nurturing a population."

"If you feel it's too costly, I can help you search for other options." Wanqu offered.

Unsuccessful transactions didn't affect the rapport, and Wanqu showed no annoyance at Lin Yuan finding the prices high.

"Trouble you, Wanqu," Lin Yuan said.

The search for a new home for human civilization wasn't urgent. From the beginning of the great cosmic destruction to complete annihilation of the Main Universe, there was still ample time. Lin Yuan could afford to wait for a more suitable "fragment world."
